title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the minimum work must be correctly calculated and presented in joules.

title: Work Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the work done to lower the temperature of the water and the work done to freeze it.

title: Thermodynamic Equations
description: Essential Criteria: The student should use appropriate thermodynamic equations for calculating work and heat transfer.

title: Temperature Change
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the initial and final temperatures in the calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations of work.

title: Heat Capacity Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the specific heat capacity value in the calculations.

title: Latent Heat Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the latent heat of fusion in the work calculation for freezing.
